title.en: Chapter 11 — The Stone in the Bird

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: يعني الحجر مشى من غرفة الكونتيسة، لحوصلة وزة.
sentences.en: Holmes said: so the stone went from the Countess's room, to a goose's crop.
To Henry Baker, to Peterson, to here.
And we must walk the road backwards.
And the first step: Henry Baker.

sentences.ar: كتب إعلان للجرايد المسائية كلها: لقينا وزة وقبعة بشارع غودج.
sentences.en: He wrote an advertisement for all the evening papers: found, a goose and a hat in Goodge Street.

sentences.ar: السيد هنري بايكر ياخدهم من بايكر ستريت 221 ب، الساعة ستة.
sentences.en: Mr. Henry Baker may have them at 221B Baker Street, at six.

sentences.ar: وقال لبيترسون: واشتري وزة بالطريق، عشان نعطيه بدل اللي أكلتها.
sentences.en: And he told Peterson: and buy a goose on the way, so we can give him one in place of the one you ate.

sentences.ar: وحط الحجر بخزنته، وقال: واطسون، شوفه.
sentences.en: And he put the stone in his safe, and said: Watson, look at it.

sentences.ar: ما إله عشرين سنة، ومات عليه رجلين، وانسجن ناس، وسمعوا حريق.
sentences.en: Not twenty years old, and two men have died over it, and people jailed, and there has been a fire.

sentences.ar: كل حجر حلو زي هيك، طعم للشيطان.
sentences.en: Every beautiful stone like this is bait for the devil.

sentences.ar: الساعة ستة ونص، دق الباب، ودخل رجل طويل.
sentences.en: At half past six, there was a knock, and a tall man came in.
Grey-haired, his face intelligent and worn.

sentences.ar: لابس معطف قديم مزرور لحد الرقبة، وما فيه قميص تحته.
sentences.en: In an old coat buttoned to the neck, with no shirt beneath.

sentences.ar: وحكى حكي مثقف، بطيء، زي واحد كان مهم وصار مش مهم.
sentences.en: And spoke educated speech, slowly, like a man who was once somebody and is no longer.
Holmes said: is this your hat?
He said: yes.
And I thought the goose was gone.
Holmes said: it is gone.
We ate it.

sentences.ar: بس اشترينا وحدة أحسن، بنفس الوزن.
sentences.en: But we bought a better one, the same weight.

sentences.ar: وتطلع هولمز بوجهه، وهو بيحكي عن الأكل.
sentences.en: And Holmes watched his face, as he spoke of the eating.
And the man laughed, and said: better!
That is better!
And took the new goose gladly.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وإذا بدنا نجيب وزة زيها، من وين كانت؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: and if we wanted a goose like it, where was it from?

sentences.ar: قال بايكر: من حانة النجمة، قريب من المتحف.
sentences.en: Baker said: from the Star Inn, near the Museum.

sentences.ar: صاحبها عمل نادي وز: كل أسبوع بندفع كم قرش، وبالعيد بناخد وزة.
sentences.en: The landlord ran a goose club: every week we pay a few pence, and at Christmas we get a goose.
And he thanked us, and left.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: ما بيعرف شي عن الحجر.
sentences.en: Holmes said: he knows nothing about the stone.
Clearly.
His face did not change.
I said: so?
He said: so, the Star Inn.
Come, in the cold, we walk fast.

sentences.ar: وصاحب الحانة قال: الوز من بائع بسوق كوفنت غاردن، اسمه بريكنريدج.
sentences.en: And the landlord said: the geese came from a dealer at Covent Garden market, named Breckinridge.
And we went to Covent Garden.

sentences.ar: بريكنريدج كان رجل طويل، وجهه حاد، ومزاجه سيء.
sentences.en: Breckinridge was a tall man, with a sharp face and a bad temper.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: الوز اللي بعته لحانة النجمة، من وين جبته؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: the geese you sold the Star, where did you get them?
The man exploded: another one!

sentences.ar: كل يوم حدا يسألني عن هالوز!
sentences.en: Every day someone asks me about those geese!
Enough!
I answer nothing!
And Holmes said calmly: it does not matter to me.
But my friend and I have a bet.

sentences.ar: أنا بقول الوزة من الريف، وهو بيقول من المدينة.
sentences.en: I say the goose was country-bred, and he says town-bred.
And he took out five pounds.

sentences.ar: الرجل ضحك ضحكة شريرة، وقال: خسرت.
sentences.en: The man gave a wicked laugh, and said: you lost.
Town-bred.
And from a woman named Oakshott, in Brixton.

sentences.ar: وفتح دفتره، وفرجانا: أربعة وعشرين وزة، من السيدة أوكشوت، لحانة النجمة.
sentences.en: And he opened his book, and showed us: twenty-four geese, from Mrs. Oakshott, to the Star Inn.
And Holmes paid the five, looking annoyed, and we went out.

sentences.ar: قال: لما واحد بيرفض يحكي، راهنه.
sentences.en: He said: when a man refuses to talk, bet him.

sentences.ar: الرهان بيفتح تمه أسرع من المصاري.
sentences.en: A wager opens his mouth faster than money.
